name: U.S. Bank Altitude Reserve Visa Infinite Card
cardStatus: CLOSED TO NEW APPLICATIONS — no longer accepting applications as of November 2024. Existing cardholders continue to hold card. Major negative changes went into effect December 15, 2025.

loungeAccess.notes: 8 complimentary visits per Priority Pass Select membership year (NOT per cardmember year). Guests count against the 8-visit allotment. After Dec 15, 2025 changes, benefits continue but verify current visit cap with U.S. Bank.

tripCancellation.notes: Visa Infinite standard benefit. Verify exact amounts in current benefit guide.

emergencyMedical.notes: Visa Infinite Emergency Evacuation and Transportation benefit. Covers medical evacuation transport. Does NOT cover actual medical treatment costs.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Visa Infinite Car Rental Privileges. Primary coverage is a key benefit for travelers.

otherCredits.name: Travel Credit
otherCredits.notes: POST Dec 15, 2025: $325 credit now restricted to US Bank Travel Center bookings only (previously applied to any travel and dining). A significant negative change from the original benefit.

otherCredits.name: Gogo Wi-Fi
otherCredits.notes: 12 complimentary Gogo Inflight Wi-Fi sessions per calendar year.

rewards.travelRate: 10x on hotels and car rentals in US Bank Travel Center; 5x on flights via US Bank Travel Center; 3x on eligible travel purchases
rewards.diningRate: 3x via mobile wallet (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay)

pointValue.transferPartners: No transfer partners — points redeemable only through US Bank or for cash

travelPerks: $325 annual travel credit (now restricted to US Bank Travel Center post-Dec 2025)
Primary rental car insurance up to $75,000
Priority Pass Select — 8 visits per membership year
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
3x on mobile wallet purchases (Apple Pay, Google Pay)
bestFor: Mobile wallet power users who want primary rental coverage and lounge access — note card is closed to new applications
